profile.headline: Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: Senior software engineer with 8+ years of financial services experience building secure, scalable backend and platform systems across Capital One and Deutsche Bank. Currently leading enterprise AI-powered vulnerability remediation and developer automation initiatives that reduce security toil and improve engineering productivity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full-stack developer for the bank’s loan origination system
• Participated in Deutsche Bank global hackathon and developed an award-winning mobile financial literacy application for high-school students that uses Facebook login and Microsoft Azure deployments
• Support-team lead, in charge of support tickets raised by users concerning our application
• Migrated database-driven VB .NET legacy application to bank’s main loan application
• Development team uses agile development heavily with business team for clear and efficient sprints

positions.title: Smart City Researcher
positions.description:
• Programmer and researcher for a digital map of Smart City (aka Digital Twin)
• Developed a 3D city model to minimize the impact of natural disasters by reading/using Big Data from
nearby building facilities using RUBY/Java/Python/SketchUp

company.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Web Developer, Java Programmer, Founder of Tar Heel Gameplay
•Developed an interactive web player (http://tarheelgameplay.org) to enable children with severe motor disabilities to play video games like typical children, and use Tar Heel Gameplay as an educational resource
• Applied agile development approach to collaborate with Director of Disability to determine requirements and attain feedback
• Successfully adopted over several schools in the Chapel Hill School District and officially recognized by UNC Chapel Hill
• Skillsets used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Python

positions.title: University IT Support
positions.description: • Learned the procedure quickly, performed regular software and hardware checks on lecture room systems, and repaired faulty classroom computers/laptops

educations.schoolName: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

honors.title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship Award
honors.description:
The Office for Undergraduate Research (OUR) is pleased to inform you that your application for a Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF) has been selected for funding.  Congratulations!  The competition for these awards was intense, as we received 196 excellent applications in a variety of fields, and we made 81 awards.  The committee was unanimous in its support of your interesting proposal, and we look forward to meeting you and hearing about your results.
- UNC Office of Undergraduate Research
honors.issuer: Issued by Krista Perreira, Professor of Public Policy · Mar 2015

volunteerExperiences.description: Maze Day is an annual event held at UNC Chapel Hill for children with vision impairments. I devised multiple games for them including Tar Heel Gameplay and a "Guitar Hero" simulator.
Dev team for the upcoming Hack NC 2016

projects.title: Tar Heel Gameplay
projects.description: Tar Heel Gameplay is designed to allow children with severe motor disabilities to play the same games as their peers do.
